assets.title: Seated display mannequin (Retail Store Fixtures and Mall)
assets.summary: A seated female display mannequin on a chamfered display cube: featureless egg head, level thighs and dropped lower legs so the feet rest on the floor, 1.4 m to the crown.
assets.description: A seated female display mannequin on a chamfered display cube: featureless egg head, level thighs and dropped lower legs so the feet rest on the floor, 1.4 m to the crown. The display cube is part of the model, so the pose is stable without a support rod and the cube reads as a plain plinth in any scheme. Dimensions 0.51 by 1.40 by 1.00 m (X by Y by Z). Metre units, +Y up, customer side toward +Z, resting on y=0. Static geometry; no rig, collision or navigation data.

usage.blender:
# Blender 4.x: File > Import > glTF 2.0, or from the Python console after downloading the file.
import bpy
bpy.ops.import_scene.gltf(filepath='model.glb')  # from https://cdn.3dassets.dev/assets/25270/v1/model.glb
# Metres and +Y up are converted to Blender's Z-up scene automatically.
usage.godot:
# Godot 4: copy model.glb into res://models/ and the editor imports it as a scene.
var packed := load("res://models/model.glb") as PackedScene
var model := packed.instantiate()
add_child(model)
